description: React component for managing custom Terms of Service settings in Mattermost admin console, including fetching, editing, and saving TOS text and related settings.

classes.name: CustomTermsOfServiceSettings
classes.description: React component class for custom Terms of Service settings in admin console.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Extracts relevant state from configuration object.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Generates configuration object from current state.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches current Terms of Service text on mount.

methods.name: doSubmit
methods.description: Handles saving the settings and creating new Terms of Service if needed.

methods.name: handleAPIError
methods.description: Handles API errors during save operations.

methods.name: getTermsOfService
methods.description: Fetches current Terms of Service text from server.

methods.name: handleTermsTextChange
methods.description: Handles change in Terms of Service text input.

methods.name: handleTermsEnabledChange
methods.description: Handles toggle of Terms of Service enabled setting.

methods.name: handleReAcceptancePeriodChange
methods.description: Handles change in re-acceptance period input.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title of the settings section.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the settings UI including toggles and text inputs.
